exemptions.reason: The gRPC surface is the shared google.iam.v1.IAMPolicy service while REST iam is service-account admin plus a resource policy; a like-for-like comparison needs a shared policy target. Tracked as AUD3-6.
IAM Credentials exposes only GenerateAccessToken/GenerateIdToken (no resource lifecycle) and the tokens are volatile; a create/get/list/delete parity flow does not apply. Tracked as AUD3-7.
Dataproc cluster/job resources carry a heavier model and region-scoped paths; the parity flow needs LRO handling plus a cluster fixture. Tracked as AUD3-8.
GKE cluster mutations return the container-specific google.container.v1.Operation (not google.longrunning), and a cluster fixture needs a node-pool model. Tracked as AUD3-9.
